title: Discover Taiwan's Creative Industry
alt: International students visiting Songshan Cultural and Creative Park
intro: An international student visit explored how cultural heritage becomes part of Taiwan’s contemporary creative industries.
paragraphs: International students explored Songshan Cultural and Creative Park during the “Discover Taiwan's Creative Industry” visit on May 27, 2026. Participants came from Vietnam, Saint Lucia, Pakistan, India, Kyrgyzstan, and Haiti, bringing a range of perspectives to the experience.

Guided tours introduced the park’s history and its transformation from a tobacco factory into a center for cultural and creative activity. Students also had time to explore independently and experience the park’s different spaces.

The visit connected Taiwan’s industrial heritage with its contemporary creative economy. Students encountered examples of how cultural sites can take on new uses while retaining a relationship with their past.

The experience encouraged reflection on creativity, cultural heritage, and collaboration across disciplines. For the participating students, it offered a chance to examine Taiwan’s creative industries beyond the classroom.
headline: Discovering Taiwan’s creative industry
teaser: A visit to Songshan Cultural and Creative Park connects students with Taiwan’s creative landscape.
facts: Venue: Songshan Cultural and Creative Park
Format: guided tours and independent exploration
